_comment: Weekly ranking rewards in POT (V, registry ranking-pot). PLACEHOLDER amounts: V settles them. The previous ISO week (Monday 00:00 UTC to Monday) is ranked on each board; the top ranks get POT in the reward box (nothing is minted before the player claims; the MintManager budget caps the emission, ADR 0018). Boards: achievements (points earned that week), world_boss (damage dealt that week), progress (new levels cleared for the first time that week).
